Official RN50 encodes eight attr_words then concatenates four per category through 4096->128->9 SPGS; E81.6 retains all eight independent text conditions instead.
Official RES uses slot-wise continuous-four-coordinate pooling, not pooling corresponding coordinates of four local tokens.
DARG lineage E744->E741->E69->E61 E2 has PEN-free CAM and weighted ClsLoss plus graph+.05pair+.01adv+.01preserve.
